s.note: Christmas Eve on the streets of New York
s.how: Split 12 mini bagels and toast until golden. Beat 200g cream cheese with 2 tbsp chopped chives and a squeeze of lemon. Spread thickly on each bagel half. Top with a ribbon of smoked salmon from 200g, a few capers, a sliver of red onion and a sprig of dill. Finish with cracked black pepper and serve on a board with lemon wedges.

s.n: Nutcracka hunt hot honey buffalo wings
s.note: the long night hunting for the Nutcracka Ball
s.how: Pat 1.2kg chicken wings dry and toss with 2 tsp baking powder and 1 tsp salt. Bake on a rack at 220C for 45 minutes, turning once, until crisp. Melt 50g butter with 100ml hot sauce and 1 tbsp honey, then toss the wings through. For the ranch, mix 100g sour cream, 3 tbsp mayonnaise, 3 tbsp buttermilk, chopped chives and dill and garlic powder. Serve with carrot and celery sticks.

m.how: Shape 500g beef mince into 12 small patties and cook with cheese slices. Serve in slider buns with pickles. Bake 250g macaroni in a cheese sauce of 200g tasty cheese and 400ml milk in muffin tins at 190C for 15 minutes.

w.note: the end of the night with the three friends
w.how: Melt 125g butter with 150g golden syrup and 100g brown sugar. Mix in 250g self-raising flour, 2 tsp ginger, 1 egg and 150ml milk. Bake at 170C for 40 minutes and ice with 150g icing sugar and lemon juice.

d.note: a cold New York Christmas Eve
d.how: Pour 750ml red wine into a saucepan with 250ml orange juice, 3 tbsp honey, 2 cinnamon sticks, 2 star anise, 6 cloves and 1 sliced orange. Heat gently for 15 minutes, keeping it below a simmer so the alcohol stays. Ladle into 4 mugs with an orange slice each. For anyone not drinking, warm sparkling apple juice with the same spices.
